title: HideBox
summary: Browser-encrypted file drive with link, word, address and pay-to-open sharing. The October 23 public how-it-works page describes browser-held keys, encrypted uploads and a SealLog record when a file leaves the drive. Losing the saved key loses access. The creator says the server observes padded sizes, timing and sharing rules; this is not a claim that all metadata is hidden. The public site and documentation were inspected without creating a drive, keys or wallet, uploading files, or making payments. MIT source; Esmeralda testnet. Recording shows the documentation and its illustrative UI, not an uploaded file.
cardSummary: Store encrypted files and share them through links, recipient addresses or paid access on Ootle testnet.
cardStatus: Web app · Testnet · Save your browser key
